A01.summary: KeeperRL: Shown: Player::chatAction selects an adjacent actor and calls Creature::chatTo. chatTo requires a humanoid speaker within distance one, returns a CreatureAction, and only its execution invokes chatReaction and spends time. Attributes select friendly or hostile text by actual enemy relation, then optionally apply chatEffect at the other actor's position with the reacting actor as source. The attribute schema has friendly/hostile lines, pet reaction and chatEffect fields; the free creature data sample uses localized reaction IDs. No populated chatEffect occurrence was found in the scanned free configuration, so the runtime hook is present but a shipped free-data chat-effect route is not established. This route is not a full reply graph; no relationship-level dialogue tree or portrait binding was found in it.
yairpg: KeeperRL: PROPOSAL: Keep preview and execution distinct in src/models/dialogue_action.js. A refusal or bark may be small, but a chat effect must still use actual actor eligibility and one committed time cost.

MainLoop distinguishes turn-based from clock-speed updates and calls Game::update under a real-time budget. Model takes the next actor from a time queue, advances periodic ticks and executes a move. A04.summary: KeeperRL: Shown: CompressedInput/Output combine gzip streams with binary Cereal archives. saveGame writes version, display name, SavedGameInfo and game to a .tmp path, copies to destination and erases the temporary file. This is a copy, not a proven atomic rename. Compatibility requires a version above two, no newer than this build, and the same version/100 band. loadFromFile itself reads but does not enforce compatibility and catches all failures only outside single-thread mode. Game/Model serialize actors, content, clocks and turn events; sunlight is recalculated. Autosaves use elapsed global game time. Profile unlocks use a separate file.
yairpg: KeeperRL: PROPOSAL: Preserve candidate-before-publish behavior in src/native_storage_transaction.js, state compatibility at every load entry, and separate run saves from profile receipts. Do not label copy-based publication atomic without a failure test.

A08.summary: KeeperRL: Shown: takeDamage computes defense from attributes, attacker-specific bonuses, flanking, lasting effects and buffs, then passes an attack/defense ratio into getDamage.
